newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MMI cleared for Singapore reinsurance.
newsitem.headline: MMI cleared for Singapore reinsurance.

text.p: Insurance group MMI Ltd said on Wednesday it had received approval from the Singapore insurance commissioner to write inward reinsurance business in Singapore.
"This (reinsurance business) provides a vital link in MMI Asian strategy," the company said in a statement.
MMI is 38 percent owned by Germany's Allianz AG.
The company said its Asian strategy had three elements:
- The opportunity to buy at least 20 percent of existing or future Allianz operations in Asia.
- The purchase of 20 percent of Allianz Singapore, which services the Singapore market, and is the hub of all Allianz re-insurance operations in Asia.
- The establishment of MMI's re-insurance inwards operation in Singapore adjacent to Allianz operation.
MMI said this three-pronged approach would ensure that the combined strengths of MMI and Allianz were applied to maximise penetration of the Asian market.
MMI shares closed one cent firmer at A$3.46.
